svg.title: Job Outreach Ops animated n8n workflow
svg.desc: A data packet moves from Google Sheets through five required-field checks, contact discovery, profile enrichment, three audience drafting stages, sheet persistence, Gmail drafts, and human review.
svg.text: One job row → a review-ready outreach queue
The animated packet follows the same admission, discovery, enrichment, drafting, and review order as the n8n workflow.
LIVE PAYLOAD · HOW THE DATA CHANGES
THE PACKET ENTERS EACH NODE, DISAPPEARS WHILE THAT NODE WORKS, THEN EXITS WITH THE NEXT PAYLOAD SHAPE
